safety: A verified-site-pairing means the current DCI launch page lists that landing within glide; it is not a prescribed real-world route.
Numeric wind envelopes are conservative simulator-authored training values, not published site limits or operational advice.
Check current DCI site rules, closures, local signs, DABS and Meiringen HX airspace status in real life.
At First, check the current Jungfrau-Tächi launch-area notice and local operating procedure; catalogue inclusion never confirms availability.
Simulator weather modes are training scenarios and never operational flight advice.
